# Field boundaries for Romania - Eurocrops

Romania - Eurocrops field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Ministry of Regional Development and Public Administration <http://spatial.mdrap.ro>, EuroCrops. License: CC-BY-SA-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/latest/ec_ro.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:32635; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name, collection, geometry, source, crop:code, id, hcat:name, hcat:name_en, metrics:area, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/collection.json
